activated_rate.description: The cashback rate shown on the Rakuten activation interstitial, exactly as displayed (e.g. "Up to 1%", "2%"). NEVER the homepage advertised rate.

merchant.description: Merchant name as shown by Rakuten (e.g. "eBay", "Macy's")

notes.description: Anything worth remembering (e.g. rate mismatch flagged, guest checkout)
notes.example: Guest checkout; attribution params verified on landing page

bearerAuth.description: Personal bearer token printed by server.py on first run (or set via CASHBACK_CONNECTOR_TOKEN). Sent as: Authorization: Bearer <token>

info.description: Bring-your-own cashback routing for Meta's Muse AI agent. The agent arms the user's own Rakuten Rewards affiliate attribution in its browser before purchasing. This API is the trip ledger: it records every purchase where cashback attribution was armed (merchant, activated rate, order reference). IMPORTANT: this ledger is maintained by the connector. It does not reflect Rakuten's records and does not confirm that cashback was credited — crediting happens on Rakuten's side, on their schedule.
info.title: Muse Cashback Connector — Trip Ledger

get.description: Returns ok:true when the connector service is running. No authentication required — use this first to verify the deployment.
Returns all trips the agent has logged as cashback-armed, newest first. These are the connector's own records, not Rakuten's.

post.description: Call this AFTER cashback attribution has been armed in the browser (Rakuten merchant activation completed, affiliate redirect followed, attribution markers verified on the merchant landing page) and the purchase is complete or placed. Do NOT call this if attribution was not armed. The activated_rate must be the rate shown on the activation interstitial, never the homepage advertised rate.

servers.description: Your deployed connector host (set when you deploy server.py)
